title: Preserve uncertainty until the exact mutation response is verified
summary: Guard confirmation before dispatch, persist minimal operation metadata, and keep an ordinary-conversation exit without treating a read as proof.
reusable_steps: Guard confirmation before dispatch, persist minimal operation metadata, and keep an ordinary-conversation exit without treating a read as proof
expected_outcome: For confirmation mutations without server receipts or revisions, a timeout, broken connection, malformed success or server error cannot prove no write occurred. Persist a minimal session-scoped attempt marker before dispatch and block related mutations; fail closed when storage cannot retain it. Distinguish known pre-write refusal from ambiguous outcomes. Only the exact live response with matching session, scope, generation and marker can settle success; retirement, BFCache, reload and replacement markers must prevent stale callbacks from clearing uncertainty. GET timestamps or saved destinations are not proof of this attempt. Keep a scoped ordinary-conversation escape and retain the marker on return. Test double clicks, storage failure, unknown outcomes, explicit rejection, late responses, reload and scope changes. Exact read reconciliation belongs in a separate server design with revision-bound receipts and atomic serialization across every writer; an atomic file rename alone is not compare-and-swap. Verified product commit: https://github.com/famaoai-creator/kyberion/commit/a033bd966d7d19599b9ddcf55be315fca7982b16; all10published blobs matched the tested manifest, including the runbook merge preserving PR1132. Local529tests and PR48 passed, real synthetic browser verified no replay; local full80/81 was blocked only by absent Playwright executable and requires exact-head CI.
